question: Padma Bhushan awardee, Alarmel Velli, who is renowned for Bharatanatyam, is also an exponent of which of the following dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odissi**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Alarmel Valli is a leading Indian classical dancer and choreographer and the foremost exponent of the Pandanallur style, in the Indian classical dance form, **Bharatanatyam**.
 
• She is widely acclaimed for her ability to turn traditional grammar into deeply internalized, personal dance poetry.
 
• She is also an exponent of which of the **Odissi **dance forms.
 
• She founded The Dipasikha Dance Foundation in Chennai in 1984, where she teaches Bharatanatyam.
 
• She was awarded the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 2001 by India's National Academy for Music, Dance, and Drama.
 
• Alarmel Valli was the second youngest dancer to be conferred the Padma Shri from the Government of India, after Vyjayanthimala.
 
• Followed by one of India's highest civilian honors – the Padma Bhushan award from the Government of India in 2004 and the Chevalier of Arts and Letters award from the Government of France, also in 2004.​
